item.title: The standard error, derived in bands
item.dc:creator: Batesthommie
item.description: Casella and Berger get Var(X-bar) = sigma squared over n from one expansion and one substitution. Here every equation carries its own numbered R line, in seven bands — ending with the check, the plug-in, Efron’s bootstrap, and why quartering the error needs quadrupling the sample.
